chunks.title: Barclays (Sustainable & Transition Finance) (Barclays) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Barclays (Sustainable & Transition Finance) is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in United Kingdom. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Major international bank delegation at COP31 Antalya focused on transition finance & climate-tech venture capital. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: $1T Sustainable and Transition Finance target by 2030 + £500M Sustainable Impact Capital mandate for climate-tech startups. Source verification: https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/nov/13/cop31-companies-and-groups-linked-to-fossil-fuels-delegations.

chunks.title: Barclays Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Barclays (Sustainable & Transition Finance) provides the following climate financing instruments: Transition Finance Loan, Green Bond Underwriting, Climate-Tech Venture Equity, Sustainability-Linked Loan. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 5,000,000 to USD 400,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Climate-Tech Startup, Project SPV, Mid-Cap Enterprise.

chunks.title: Barclays Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Barclays (Sustainable & Transition Finance): Industrial Decarbonization, Climate-Tech Innovation, Renewable Energy, Energy Storage, Clean Transport. Target geographic focus includes: Global, United Kingdom, Europe, North America, EMEA, Asia-Pacific. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: Barclays Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete Barclays's application form: Barclays Transition Finance Framework (TFF) eligibility; Verified corporate decarbonization plan & KPIs; Commercial creditworthiness or Series A-C venture traction; External assurance / SPO for labeled facilities. Explicit exclusion rules: New upstream oil & gas projects; Thermal coal expansion. Official application portal: https://www.ib.barclays/our-insights/sustainable-finance.html.

chunks.title: Barclays Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Barclays (Sustainable & Transition Finance) uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
